# Decompressing

A reader that decompresses a stream as it is read.

<h2 id="decompress-reader"><code>DecompressReader</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct DecompressReader {
    // private fields
}
```

A reader that decompresses what it reads from another, in any of the three formats.
Reading it to the end fails with `EndOfStream` once the data and its checksum have been read; damaged or truncated
input fails with `InvalidInput`, and so does every read after. A gzip stream of several members reads as their
data one after another. Not copied.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Compress/Src/Inflate.rux#L30)

**Associated functions**

<h3 id="new"><code>New</code></h3>

```rux
pub func New(
    allocator: Allocator,
    source: Reader,
    format: Format
) -> DecompressReader ! IoError
```

A reader of the data `source` holds compressed in `format`.

| Name        | Type        | Description                                            |
| ----------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `allocator` | `Allocator` | what the reader's input buffer and history are kept in |
| `source`    | `Reader`    | the compressed stream, which the reader takes          |
| `format`    | `Format`    | the container the stream is in                         |

**Returns**: the reader, or fails when the allocator refused

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Compress/Src/Inflate.rux#L64)

**Implements Reader**

`DecompressReader` conforms to `Reader`.

<h3 id="read"><code>Read</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Read(
    self: &var DecompressReader,
    into: var char8[..]
) -> uint ! IoError
```

Decompresses into `into` until it is full or the data ends.

| Name   | Type            | Description           |
| ------ | --------------- | --------------------- |
| `into` | `var char8[..]` | where to put the data |

**Returns**: how many bytes were produced, or fails with `EndOfStream` after the last, or with `InvalidInput` for
damaged or truncated input

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Compress/Src/Inflate.rux#L404)
